vintage: Recensement de la population Nouvelle-Calédonie 2019, updated 2021-06-23
methodology: Commune-level counts from the 2019 New Caledonia census are distributed over commune polygons and summed within each hex. Values cover only New Caledonia; the rest of France is null because these are territory-specific census tables.

lenses.name: New Caledonia residents 65+
lenses.description: Residents aged 65 or older as a share of all residents. Commune-level counts from the 2019 New Caledonia census are distributed over commune polygons and summed within each hex. Values cover only New Caledonia; the rest of France is null because these are territory-specific census tables.
